description: Hasil survei kepuasan fiktif: 18 responden kasih skor 0-10. Dipakai buat belajar CASE: kategorikan jadi Promoter, Passive, Detractor ala NPS.

samples.label: kategorikan skor
samples.sql: SELECT nama, skor, CASE WHEN skor >= 9 THEN 'Promoter' WHEN skor >= 7 THEN 'Passive' ELSE 'Detractor' END AS kategori FROM survei;

samples.label: hitung per kategori
samples.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN skor >= 9 THEN 'Promoter' WHEN skor >= 7 THEN 'Passive' ELSE 'Detractor' END AS kategori, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM survei GROUP BY kategori;
